readiness_verdict.decision_rationale:
Although the conflation infrastructure, graph partitioning, annotation protocol, and adjudication workflows are fully mature (6 of 9 criteria passing), the human-verified benchmark is NOT YET READY for training supervised machine learning models (such as LightGBM or XGBoost). Specifically:
1. The current gold-standard benchmark comprises 50 targeted ambiguity cases rather than the 500-pair representative sample.
2. The 86% MATCH prevalence in M11 reflects graph anomaly filtering, not natural population prevalence.
3. Training a classifier on this dataset would cause severe distribution shift and overfit to targeted cluster conflicts.
RECOMMENDATION: Complete human annotation across the remaining 450 pairs of the representative queue (Dataset A) before launching supervised model training.

quality_gate_checklist.current_status: 50 targeted human-verified pairs + 1 representative human pair (51 total human labels; 49 auto-adopted AI diagnostic)
quality_gate_checklist.critical_gap: Human annotation volume on representative 500-pair queue is incomplete (450 pairs pending).

quality_gate_checklist.target: Balanced representation of Match, Non-Match, and Hard Negatives
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: M11 benchmark is 86% MATCH (43/50) and 14% NON_MATCH (7/50)
quality_gate_checklist.critical_gap: Targeted ambiguity benchmark is heavily skewed towards positive matches. Training supervised ML on this alone would produce severe positive bias.

quality_gate_checklist.target: Population-representative stratified coverage across all 10 candidate strata
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: M11 benchmark covers only 2 strata (Tier-1 Contradictions and Tier-2 Competing Edges)
quality_gate_checklist.critical_gap: Lacks verified coverage across phonetic variants, large distance candidates, and generic names.

quality_gate_checklist.target: Formal adjudication mechanism with auditable rationales and strict provenance
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: AdjudicationWorkflow fully implemented; 3 cases adjudicated with detailed rationales

quality_gate_checklist.target: Explicit abstention tracking; no forcing of ambiguous pairs into binary labels
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: UNCERTAIN class formally preserved in schema and evaluated in baseline

quality_gate_checklist.target: Native Kannada script and transliterated pairs represented in evaluation
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: Subgroup evaluation disaggregated by Kannada and transliteration status

quality_gate_checklist.target: Component-blocked and spatial H3-7 isolated Train/Val/Test splits
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: ComponentBlockedPartitioner verified with 0 cross-split components and 0 shared nodes

quality_gate_checklist.target: Strict physical and schema separation between AI-adopted diagnostic data and human ground truth
quality_gate_checklist.current_status: Enforced via AnnotationProvenance enum and dedicated storage files

prerequisites_for_supervised_modeling: Complete primary human review for the remaining 450 unannotated pairs in data/processed/benchmark/annotation_queue.csv.
Execute blind secondary review on >= 100 representative pairs (20% sample in assigned_representative_qc_representative_reviewer_2.csv).
Resolve any dual-reviewer disagreements through senior adjudication.
Verify that representative benchmark captures at least 150 confirmed matches and 150 confirmed non-matches.
Re-run ComponentBlockedPartitioner on the finalized representative benchmark.
